setup.text: The postman pauses along the fence line, the mailbag heavy on one shoulder. He presses his shoulder blade against a post and grimaces, unable to reach the spot.

option_a.text:
The player gestures toward the man's shoulder. "Can't reach it?"

The postman grimaces as he shifts his weight. "Right between the shoulder blades. I can never quite reach that spot properly."

option_b.text: The player hands over a scrap of wool for him to work with. The postman settles the fabric against the itch and his shoulders drop and roll once.

option_c.text: The player presses the wool against the post. No relief comes.
